programme.title: Red Bull Rampage 2026

programme.title: Reel Rock

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.desc: Big wall free climbing masters Babsi and Jacopo seek their greatest challenge yet: a free ascent of Eternal Flame, an elusive 3,000ft (914km). route up the legendary Nameless Tower in Pakistan.

programme.title: Reel Rock

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.desc: Seb Bouin’s DNA (9c) features upside-down foot dynos, barely-real holds and endless movement out of a massive cave in France, signalling that Seb’s at the cutting edge of human performance on rock.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.desc: World class rock climber Leo Houlding, Cumbrian climber Anna Taylor and jungle expert Waldo Etherington undertake a big wall expedition to climb a new route on the overhanging prow of Mount Roraima.

programme.title: Reel Rock

programme.title: Reel Rock
